name: My Zypps - Ounce - Apple Fritter
description:
Sun-grown, full-bud, full ounce. The My Zypps Apple Fritter ounce delivers a full 28 grams of quality sun-grown flower — cured for full flavor and a smooth, even burn.

Apple Fritter serves up that fresh-out-the-oven flavor: sweet baked apple and warm cinnamon-sugar notes up front with a smooth, glazed-pastry finish.

28G sun-grown flower — full ounce of whole bud
Best value — full-ounce pricing at the lowest cost per gram
Signature Apple Fritter flavor — sweet baked apple and cinnamon sugar with a glazed finish

My Zypps Apple Fritter is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
